newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Beverage posts Q4 net after buys.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Beverage posts Q4 net after buys.

text.p: Atlantic Beverage Co Inc said Friday its profit in the fourth quarter stemmed in part from five food company acquisitions it closed in 1996.

Net income in the period ended December 31 reached $223,887, or $0.03 a share, compared to a loss of $3.0 million, or $1.28 a share, one year ago. The 1995 figure included a $2.9-milllion loss related to discontinued operations, the company said.
Atlantic Beverage said the new units helped sales climb to $42.4 million from $3.8 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company markets processed meat products and non-alcoholic beverages.
Its shares were trading down 1/4 Friday at 3-1/4.
